_comment: Authoritative status of every position dataset. Machine-readable companion
to DATA-STATUS.md. Checked by scripts/validate_datasets.py, which fails on
any problem that is neither declared here nor listed in accepted_problems.
Statuses: OK | QUARANTINED (do not use for new work) | RETIRED (champion

positions-amalgam_unique.pt.note: champAa baseline, correctly built from its own four opponent modes. champS4's dataset is a copy of this file; that is champS4's defect, not this one's.

positions-amalgam_s4_unique.pt.reason: Byte-identical to champAa's dataset -- champS4 was never measured on its own distribution. Its Sa_archScan self-play raws exist, so it is rebuildable, but champS4 is retired as of 2026-08-11 rather than rebuilt.
positions-amalgam_s4_unique.pt.do_not: Do not present champS4-vs-champAa as a distribution comparison. It is the same positions under two models -- a clean MODEL comparison, and the only claim these numbers support.

positions-amalgam_ta_unique.pt.reason: Aggregated from positions-random_v_random_raw.pt ALONE: contains zero model-generated positions. It is pure random-vs-random play under champAa's game module. Every champTa SAE was trained on these activations and every *Ta label tensor scores this distribution.
consequences: champTa tiger base rates are ~2x other champions (0.045 vs 0.023) because random play blunders into winnable positions far more often -- this is NOT a property of champTa.
Every champTa-vs-other comparison is confounded on three axes: distribution, sample size, base rate.
All champTa results are marked provisional in RESEARCH-STATUS.md.
positions-amalgam_ta_unique.pt.fix: runners/champTa-rebuild.ps1 -- the three self-play raws exist (263,393 positions); nothing needs regenerating, only re-aggregating.

positions-amalgam_ve_unique.pt.note: Correctly built from all four Ve_oracleAblation opponent modes under quarto_s4.

positions-amalgam_yb_unique.pt.note: Correctly built from all four Yb_hotChamp opponent modes under quarto_s4_hot.

positions-amalgam_all_unique.pt.reason: 677,744 positions, but its composition inherits the defects above: of five inputs, two are champAa's positions (amalgam + amalgam_s4, identical) and one is random-play-only (amalgam_ta). Only champVe and champYb contribute agent-generated positions.
positions-amalgam_all_unique.pt.fix: Rebuild with runners/unified-pool.ps1 AFTER champTa-rebuild. The position-count suffix changes, so gorilla677k/hawk677k/tiger677k label sets are superseded too.

derived_artifacts_quarantined._comment: Everything computed from a QUARANTINED dataset inherits its status.
derived_artifacts_quarantined.saes: saes/quarto/*champTa*.pt and their eval_registry rows (key suffix :gorillaTa/:hawkTa/:tigerTa)
